headline: Linn of Mercy Erupts as Kuura Strand Fighting Rekindles
war_summary: Fresh fighting has broken out at Linn of Mercy, where fourteen changes of flag were logged in the past day and six more within two hours of this edition, all centred on Outwich Ranch; nine posts there stand Colonial, one Warden, and one lies ruined and unclaimed. Kuura Strand, briefly stilled, has reignited — nearly three hundred Colonial and one hundred sixty Warden casualties fell in the last two hours, though the four-to-two Colonial footing held. At Pari Peak the contested ground has been resolved, leaving the Colonials four bases to one. Weathered Expanse remains the war's great furnace: sixty-one base events in a day, a third post now destroyed and unreclaimed, with movement still logged as this report closed at Spirit Watch and Frostmarch. Marban Hollow's long seesaw at Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall has gone quiet since the small hours, and traffic at Stlican Shelf's Breaker Town has thinned. Away from the flag changes, the guns grind on at Callahan's Passage, Stonecradle, and Olavis Wake, where losses mount heavily without a base changing hands. This is the war's 661st day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.
